payload.abstract: The data in this collection include: (1) 6 surrogate stationary signals with different correlations; (2) 7 surrogate correlated signals with linear, sinusoidal and power-law trends; and (3) 15 surrogate correlated signals with different types of nonstationarities. Each data file contains one column of data in ASCII format.

payload.short_description: Data collected for a study on a scaling analysis method used to estimate long-range power-law correlation exponents in noisy signals.
payload.title: Surrogate Data with Correlations, Trends, and Nonstationarities
